time.rule: time[i] (UTC epoch s) = t0_unix + i*step_seconds; local wall time = UTC+4 (no DST). Radiation at index i is the mean over [time[i]-1h, time[i]).

shortwave_radiation.desc: Global horizontal irradiance (GHI), mean of the hour ending at the timestamp

direct_radiation.desc: Direct (beam) irradiance on the HORIZONTAL plane, preceding-hour mean

underlying.era5: ERA5 hourly reanalysis, Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) — contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information
underlying.era5_seamless: ERA5-Land (T/RH/Td) merged with ERA5 (wind, radiation, pressure), C3S
underlying.ecmwf_ifs: ECMWF IFS HRES 9 km (O1280) analysis/short-range series assembled by Open-Meteo, ECMWF data CC BY 4.0
underlying.ecmwf_ifs025: ECMWF IFS 0.25° open data (3-hourly output interpolated to hourly by Open-Meteo), CC BY 4.0
underlying.dwd_icon_seamless: DWD ICON global/EU/D2 seamless (global ~11 km at these sites), CC BY 4.0
underlying.ncep_gfs_seamless: NOAA NCEP GFS 0.11°/0.25° seamless (US Government open data)

source.changes: Re-packaged into column arrays; values not modified.
